label: Persistent internal alarm or wired state
operational_definition: Subjective alarm-like activation not reducible to a single peripheral symptom.

label: Body-before-thought ordering
operational_definition: Bodily activation explicitly precedes or occurs without initiating worry/fear cognition.

label: No consciously identified trigger
operational_definition: Writer explicitly reports no psychological or situational trigger.

label: Discrete panic-like attacks
operational_definition: Abrupt bounded episodes, coded separately from baseline state.

label: Inter-episode baseline recovery
operational_definition: Return to baseline between episodes.

label: Palpitations or forceful heartbeat
operational_definition: Awareness of pounding, forceful, skipped, or rapid heartbeat.

label: Measured tachycardia
operational_definition: Instrument-confirmed high heart rate as reported.

label: Measured normal or low heart rate
operational_definition: Instrument-reported normal/not-high/bradycardic heart rate without assuming simultaneity.

label: Blood-pressure abnormality
operational_definition: Reported high, low, or labile blood pressure.

label: Accelerated or overly intense thoughts
operational_definition: Subjective thought speed/intensity increase without inferring mania.

label: Brain fog or cognitive slowing
operational_definition: Subjective cognitive clouding, slowing, attention, or memory difficulty.

label: Ambiguous mental disorientation
operational_definition: Writer uses confusion/disorientation language without enough detail to classify literally.

label: Altered cognitive flow or appraisal
operational_definition: Thoughts no longer flow naturally or are hard to evaluate calmly.

label: Derealization
operational_definition: World feels unreal/dreamlike with reality testing coded separately.

label: Depersonalization
operational_definition: Self feels detached/unreal with reality testing coded separately.

label: Dreamlike or altered-presence experience
operational_definition: Unreal, high, drugged, concussed, screen-like, or distant presence not otherwise specified.

label: Embodiment disturbance
operational_definition: Altered ownership, body–brain connection, floating, or outside-body experience.

label: Fatigue or exhaustion
operational_definition: Fatigue distinct from sleepiness where possible.

label: PEM or post-exertional worsening
operational_definition: Delayed or prolonged worsening after exertion; self-label and operational features separated.

label: Nausea
operational_definition: Mild to severe nausea as reported.

label: Urinary urgency or nocturia
operational_definition: Urgency, frequency, or nighttime urination.

label: Involuntary internal scanning
operational_definition: Automatic intrusive monitoring/prominence of internal signals.

label: Deliberate body checking or monitoring
operational_definition: Intentional checking, reassurance seeking, or chosen body scan.

label: Abnormally intense bodily presence
operational_definition: Body feels excessively present, salient, or amplified.

label: Internal vibration or buzzing
operational_definition: Internally perceived vibration, buzzing, or tremulousness.

label: Palpitations or apparent tachycardia with simultaneous non-high HR
operational_definition: Severe heartbeat sensation paired with contemporaneous normal/not-high measured rate.

label: Air hunger with simultaneous non-abnormal simple measure
operational_definition: Air hunger paired with contemporaneous oxygen/respiratory measure reported non-abnormal.

label: Internal severity with outward composure
operational_definition: Reported severe internal state despite little externally visible activation.

label: Quiet or low-stimulation prominence
operational_definition: Symptoms worsen or become more prominent in quiet/neutral contexts.

label: Salient engagement masks symptoms
operational_definition: Social, emotional, or absorbing engagement reduces awareness/prominence without assumed physiological resolution.

label: External sensory input worsens symptoms
operational_definition: Light, sound, touch, screens, or busy settings worsen symptoms.

label: Postural modulation
operational_definition: Lying, sitting, standing, or orthostasis changes symptoms.

label: Exertional worsening or PEM-like pattern
operational_definition: Physical/cognitive exertion followed by worsening; formal PEM not assumed.

label: Meal or food modulation
operational_definition: Food/meal temporally changes symptoms.

label: Stress or emotional provocation
operational_definition: Stress/emotion triggers or worsens the reported state.

label: Inner restlessness
operational_definition: Internal urge or inability to feel still.

label: Observable pacing or motor urge
operational_definition: Pacing, inability to sit, repetitive movement, or objective motor restlessness.

label: Medication-timed akathisia-like syndrome
operational_definition: Restlessness temporally linked to medication start/change/withdrawal; diagnosis not assumed.

label: Head pressure
operational_definition: Pressure, squeezing, tight-band, or skull-too-small sensation.

label: Head or brain burning sensation
operational_definition: Subjective internal burning/heat in head.

label: Twitching, tremor, or shaking
operational_definition: Involuntary or subjectively internal movement phenomenon.

label: Startle sensitivity
operational_definition: Increased or exaggerated startle response.

label: Sensory sensitivity
operational_definition: Light, sound, touch, visual, or multisensory intolerance.

label: Dizziness, presyncope, or syncope
operational_definition: Dizziness through loss-of-consciousness spectrum, coded with exact wording.

label: Diffuse bodily discomfort or pain
operational_definition: Widespread or hard-to-localize pain/discomfort.

label: Initiating worry or rumination
operational_definition: Worry/fear cognition reported before bodily activation.

label: Secondary fear or distress
operational_definition: Fear/distress follows or reacts to bodily/cognitive symptoms.

label: Fear of going crazy with insight
operational_definition: Meta-cognitive fear/interpretation with preserved or unlost reality testing.

label: Hallucination-like experience
operational_definition: Perception without external stimulus; modality/content and insight required.

label: Delusional or fixed false belief
operational_definition: Fixed conviction not culturally sanctioned; coder must not infer from odd thoughts alone.

label: Formal thought disorder or gross disorganization
operational_definition: Disorganized thought/speech/behavior explicitly described.

label: Loss or impairment of reality testing
operational_definition: Explicit impaired reality testing or inability to recognize experience as altered.

label: Mania or hypomania feature cluster
operational_definition: Elevated/expansive mood, decreased need for sleep, grandiosity, goal-directed activation, or risk behavior; single accelerated-thought report is insufficient.

label: Depressed mood or anhedonia
operational_definition: Mood/anhedonia report kept separate from fatigue and DPDR.

label: Suicidality or self-harm
operational_definition: Passive death wish, ideation, intent, plan, attempt, or self-harm; immediacy coded separately.

label: Trauma-linked symptoms
operational_definition: Cue-linked re-experiencing, avoidance, nightmares, or hyperarousal.

label: Obsessive or compulsive checking
operational_definition: Intrusions, compulsions, reassurance seeking, or voluntary checking pattern.

label: Psychiatric label or dismissal only
operational_definition: Psychiatric terminology without enough direct phenomenology.

label: Air hunger or dyspnea
operational_definition: Unsatisfied breathing or shortness of breath.

label: Hyperventilation or low CO2
operational_definition: Reported hyperventilation, hypocapnia, or low carbon dioxide.

label: Sleep initiation preserved
operational_definition: Ability to fall asleep reported relatively preserved.

label: Sleep maintenance preserved
operational_definition: Ability to remain asleep reported relatively preserved.

label: Non-restorative sleep
operational_definition: Sleep does not restore normal state.

label: Insomnia
operational_definition: Difficulty initiating or maintaining sleep.

label: Nocturnal awakenings or sleep-boundary surges
operational_definition: Repeated waking or jolts/surges around sleep.

label: Present at first consciousness
operational_definition: State already present immediately on waking before standing, phone use, food, or medication when specified.

label: Continuous or 24/7 baseline
operational_definition: Unbroken or nearly unbroken baseline state.

label: Episodic pattern
operational_definition: Bounded attacks or episodes with meaningful intervals.

label: Relapsing-remitting course
operational_definition: Longer flares and remissions over time.

label: No true return to baseline
operational_definition: Explicit absence of symptom-free baseline.

label: Onset after reported infection
operational_definition: Symptoms reported to begin after infection; temporal association only.

label: Worsening after reinfection
operational_definition: Reported worsening temporally following another infection.

label: Gradual onset
operational_definition: Symptoms emerge progressively rather than abruptly.

label: Slow partial improvement
operational_definition: Incomplete improvement over months/years.
